messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Species names at the tips not showing
parts:
Hi- make sure you see tip names in the example script with a small tree first. If you do, then missing names in your own data might happen eg with a large PDF or other changes to the plot settings. The main thing to do is play with plot_BioGeoBEARS_results options. Type “plot_BioGeoBEARS_results” in R, then scroll to the top to see the options. I’m on leave on my phone but eg cex means character expansion etc

Cheers, nick
